items.title: OpenBSD 8.0 Released With Major Security Hardening and Post-Quantum SSH Support
items.description: OpenBSD 8.0 has been released with security fixes across its kernel, network services, firewall, and update tools, alongside experimental post-quantum SSH signature support. Released on October 20, 2026, the project’s 61st release includes OpenSSH 10.6 and LibreSSL 4.4.0, bringing stronger checks for untrusted data and changes to secure connection handling. items.description: The Emperador ransomware group claims to have stolen 3.9GB of data from AB InBev and demands $1 million in Bitcoin, but the alleged breach remains unverified, with no company confirmation reported. items.title: PHP Releases New Windows Build Security Updates to Fix Critical HTTP2Shell Vulnerability
items.description: The PHP team has released updated Windows builds to fix a serious flaw known as HTTP2Shell. The new packages are PHP 8.5.12-1, 8.4.27-1, 8.3.36-1, and 8.2.35-1, and PHP announced them on October 26, 2026. Each build now includes Brotli 1.2.1, which fixes CVE-2026-111497.
